title: Berkeley parapsychology professor quits Mishlove's committee over Owens research
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Berkeley parapsychology professor quits Mishlove's committee over Owens research, about 1970s at Berkeley, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: graduate student at Berkeley in the 1970s and I began doing research with this fellow Ted Owens who claimed to be in telepathic contact with aliens, my uh one of my professors in parasychology dropped off the committee because he said we just can't combine these two fields.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of the mind and psychic phenomena, says that in the 1970s, as a graduate student at the University of California, Berkeley, he began studying a man named Ted Owens, who claimed to be in telepathic contact with aliens. According to Mishlove, one of his professors in parapsychology, the study of claimed psychic abilities, quit his thesis committee, saying the two fields just could not be combined. He tells it to show that the alien topic was kept apart even from other unusual science.
